stories.headline: Nscale commits $3.5B of compute and up to 100,000 Nvidia GPUs to humanoid maker Figure

key_facts.fact: On September 3, 2026, London-based AI cloud provider Nscale signed a multi-year strategic partnership with humanoid robotics company Figure, with an initial commitment of $3.5 billion of compute and intent to scale beyond $6 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: London, U.K. 3 September 2026 – Nscale, a full-stack AI cloud platform, today announced it has signed a multi-year strategic partnership with humanoid robotics company Figure... an initial commitment of $3.5 billion of compute and the intent to scale to over $6 billion.

key_facts.fact: The deal covers deployment of Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform with up to 100,000 GPUs, with the first systems targeted for the second half of 2027 in Barstow, Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal represents the potential to deploy the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform with up to 100,000 NVIDIA GPUs. The initial GPUs are targeted for deployment starting the second half of 2027 in Barstow, Texas.

key_facts.fact: Nscale will also make an undisclosed strategic investment in Figure, becoming a shareholder and Figure's preferred compute provider for its Helix models.
key_facts.excerpt: Nscale said it will become a Figure shareholder and its preferred compute provider through the deal, powering the next generation of Figure's Helix models and humanoid robotics.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang framed the deal as a 'robotics flywheel': training Figure's models on Vera Rubin via Nscale's cloud, validating them in Nvidia Isaac Sim, and deploying them on Nvidia GPUs inside Figure's robots.
key_facts.excerpt: "Nscale and Figure have activated the robotics flywheel: training Figure's models on NVIDIA Vera Rubin through Nscale's AI cloud, validating them in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and deploying them on NVIDIA GPUs in Figure's robots."

key_facts.fact: Neither company disclosed the size of Nscale's equity investment, payment schedules, or what share of the 100,000 GPUs the initial commitment covers; Figure was last valued at about $39 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Neither announcement defines payment schedules, minimum capacity, cancellation terms or the portion of the 100,000 GPUs covered by the initial commitment... The announcements do not specify the investment amount, valuation, ownership percentage or closing date.

key_facts.fact: The parties will also explore using Figure humanoids in Nscale's own data-center supply chain.
key_facts.excerpt: As part of the partnership, the parties will also explore the potential to scale Nscale's supply chain with humanoids.

stories.headline: Crusoe raises $3B+ at a ~$30B valuation and signs a ~$13B GPU deal with Jane Street

key_facts.fact: Crusoe, a cloud-computing provider and data center developer, raised more than $3 billion at a roughly $30 billion post-money valuation, co-led by Atreides Management and Valor Equity Partners with Mubadala Capital participating.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources: Crusoe raised $3B+ at a ~$30B post-money valuation; Atreides Management and Valor Equity Partners co-led the round, with Mubadala Capital participating. Crusoe, a cloud-computing provider and data center developer doing business with OpenAI, Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc.

key_facts.fact: Separately on the same day, Crusoe signed a roughly $13 billion, five-year deal with trading firm Jane Street to supply GPUs and other infrastructure for AI training and inference through its cloud platform.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources: Crusoe signed a ~$13B, five-year deal with Jane Street to provide GPUs and other infrastructure for AI training and inference via its cloud platform.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe already does business with OpenAI, Microsoft and Meta, and is a developer of the Stargate data-center site in Abilene, Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: Crusoe, a cloud-computing provider and data center developer doing business with OpenAI, Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc.

stories.headline: DeepSeek plans to run a new data center on 160,000+ Huawei Ascend 950DT chips

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 of Huawei's top Ascend 950DT accelerators at a large data center it is building in Inner Mongolia.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 of Huawei Technologies Co.'s top accelerators at a massive data center it's building.

key_facts.fact: The order would create one of the largest clusters of Huawei chips anywhere, a milestone for China's push to substitute domestic silicon for Nvidia hardware restricted by US export controls.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources: DeepSeek plans to use 160K+ of Huawei's Ascend 950DT chips at an Inner Mongolia data center, which would create one of the largest Huawei chip clusters.

key_facts.fact: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said China has not taken up President Trump's offer to sell it Nvidia H200-class chips and equivalents from AMD, and that he therefore sees no need to loosen export controls further.
key_facts.excerpt: "President Trump made an offer to sell H200 chips and video chips to China, and they're equivalent from AMD and others," Lutnick said. "And the Chinese haven't really taken it up." ... "The president showed an olive branch, and it hasn't been taken up, so I think we're just gonna let it go."

stories.headline: Nvidia sets October launch for RTX Spark N1X laptops and opens a home AI compute router

key_facts.fact: Nvidia said its RTX Spark N1X ships in October in two configurations: a 20-core CPU paired with a 6,144-core Blackwell GPU, and an 18-core CPU with a 5,120-core GPU, with up to 128GB of unified memory.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X launches in October for laptops and desktops — 18 or 20 CPU cores, paired with 5,120 or 6,144 CUDA cores, up to 128GB of unified memory

key_facts.fact: The 18-core SKU will be offered with 24GB to 32GB of unified memory, according to specs shared from Nvidia's IFA announcement.
key_facts.excerpt: @aschilling: There will be two SKUs of @NVIDIARTXSpark: - 20 CPU-Cores / 6.144 Shader Units - 18 CPU-Cores / 5,120 Shader Units. The SKU with 18 CPU-Cores will be available with 24-32 GB unified memory.

key_facts.fact: Also at IFA, Nvidia launched Personal AI Router (PAIR) in beta, a free tool that automatically links machines on a home network and routes local AI inference requests to whichever system has spare capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: PAIR is designed to get your desktop and laptop working together on local AI tasks when not in use. @nvidiartxspark: Just announced at IFA, NVIDIA PAIR automatically links systems across your local network and sends inference requests wherever there's available capacity.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia said Nous Research is bringing one-click local model setup for its Hermes Agent to Nvidia systems on Windows and Linux as part of the local-AI push.
key_facts.excerpt: @nvidiartxspark: Local AI agents should be easy to set up. That's why @NousResearch is bringing one-click local model setup to Hermes Agent across NVIDIA systems on Windows and Linux.

stories.headline: Thailand suspends construction of 49 data centers over resource strain

key_facts.fact: Thailand's government suspended construction of 49 data centers while it develops new rules for the industry.
key_facts.excerpt: Thailand suspends the construction of 49 data centers in order to develop new industry regulations, as governments worldwide tighten oversight of the facilities.

key_facts.fact: The suspension follows public concern about the strain the server farms place on local power and water resources.
key_facts.excerpt: Thailand's embrace of data centers hit a speed bump after the government suspended construction of 49 server farms as public concerns...

key_facts.fact: The move fits a wider pattern of governments tightening oversight of data-center construction.
key_facts.excerpt: ...as governments worldwide tighten oversight of the facilities.

stories.headline: Bank of Korea: Korea's memory output lead over China's CXMT is set to widen through 2028

key_facts.fact: A Bank of Korea report projects South Korea's monthly memory chip output will grow by roughly 600,000 wafers by 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of Korea: South Korea's monthly memory chip output is set to grow by ~600K wafers by 2028, widening its lead over China's CXMT, set to grow by ~300K wafers.

key_facts.fact: China's CXMT is projected to add about 300,000 wafers of monthly output over the same period, half of Korea's expansion, leaving the gap wider than today.
key_facts.excerpt: ...widening its lead over China's CXMT, set to grow by ~300K wafers.

sources.title: Korea's Memory Chip Lead Over China Set to Grow, Report Says
